run_multimodal_training: run the multimodal training script with tyro CLI to train a D360 model on gesture data
create_modality_config: create a ModalityConfig dataclass to configure RGB, IMU, mic, specgram, and pressure modalities for training
build_data_loader: build train and test data loaders from D360 datasets using get_data_loader with a specified batch size
review_main_entry: review the main function that parses CLI args, sets seeds, creates the model, optimizer, and trainer
test_get_data_loader: test the get_data_loader function to verify it returns train and test PyTorch DataLoader instances
